abstract: Chapter 15 explores Ascension to Heaven through the lens of Atman, revealing the universal truths woven into the Mahabharata narrative.
objectives: Understand the role of Atman in Ascension to Heaven.
Analyze key character motivations in Chapter 15.
Connect philosophical teachings to real-world ethics.

content_blocks.content: The narrative of Chapter 15 centres on Ascension to Heaven. The characters face choices that test the boundaries of Atman — the cosmic order that governs all actions.

content_blocks.english_translation: You have a right to perform your duty, but not to its fruits.
content_blocks.content: This verse defines selfless action — the bedrock of the Gita's teaching.
Atman as explored in Ascension to Heaven reveals that true freedom lies in detachment from outcome while remaining fully committed to righteous action.
By the end of Chapter 15, the reader understands that the battlefield of Kurukshetra is also the battlefield of the human mind — where every soul must choose between ego and truth.
